text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is just about to start. Mejiro McQueen calmly reflects on everything that's led up to this day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She thinks back on the effort both she and I have put forth and on her many experiences competing with her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also recalls her race against Mejiro Ryan, who showed a sense of resolve stronger than ever before in the Takarazuka Kinen

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Filled with determination, Mejiro McQueen vows to expend all her power to win today's autumn Tenno Sho.
